Name: Magic
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Magic[/b] adds a full spell system to the game.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7831]Mana Bar[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
[b]See [url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/tree/develop/Magic#use]how to use Magic[/url] in the readme![/b]

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

[/list]
